package rulefixtures

import (
	"database/sql"
)

// scenario for prepare_inside_loop: Prepare(...) or PrepareContext(...) observed inside loops.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: data_access; severity: contextual.
func QueryInLoop(db *sql.DB, ids []int) error {
	for _, id := range ids {
		stmt, err := db.Prepare("SELECT name, email FROM users WHERE id = $1")
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		var name, email string
		if err := stmt.QueryRow(id).Scan(&name, &email); err != nil {
			stmt.Close()
			return err
		}
		stmt.Close()
		_, _ = name, email
	}
	return nil
}
